title: Transfer window: get updates for your favourite club in Europe's top leagues
trail: Sign up to receive Facebook Messenger notifications when your club in the Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1 or La Liga are involved in a transfer
body: The Guardian can now keep you updated with all the latest deals and rumours from the Premier League, La Liga, the Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1. Follow your clubs Just tell the chatbot your favourite clubs and it will alert you each time there is a confirmed or updated signing. You’ll receive a simple notification like this: Stay ahead of the game The subscribers who want to can also receive the Rumour Mill - our daily round-up of the latest rumours, fees and general gossip from the world of football. Let us know what you think This is the latest feature of the Guardian chatbot - we have plenty more ideas waiting on the sideline. We really value your ideas and feedback. Please email the team at chatbot.feedback@theguardian.com. Get started Simply click the kick off button below
